Meet the 2026 Ford F-450SD King Ranch DRW—a heavy-duty truck built to handle the most demanding jobs while delivering the premium comfort and capability you expect from King Ranch.

This truck comes equipped with standout features designed for serious work and refined daily driving:

- 6.7L High Output Power Stroke V8 Diesel with 10-Speed Automatic and 4WD
- FX4 Off-Road Package with Hill Descent Control and off-road tuned suspension
- Snow Plow/Camper Package with reinforced springs and auxiliary support
- Tough Bed Spray-In Bedliner with bed tie-down hooks
- Twin Panel Power Moonroof
- SYNC 4 with 12" Center Display and Connected Navigation
- B&O Unleashed Sound System with 14 speakers and SiriusXM 360L
- Max Recline leather seats with 10-way power driver adjustment
- 410 Amp Dual Alternators for maximum electrical capacity
- Rapid-Heat Supplemental Cab Heater and Engine Block Heater
- SecuriCode Keyless Entry Keypad
- Six Upfitter Switches in overhead console
- 19.5" Forged Polished Aluminum Wheels with color-matched custom lift
- Ford Connectivity Package with 5G modem and internet access

The F-450SD Super Duty platform delivers serious payload capacity with a 14,000 lb GVWR, making it ready for commercial applications, specialized equipment, or demanding recreational pursuits. The 6.7L diesel engine combines raw capability with modern efficiency, while the FX4 package ensures you can confidently navigate challenging terrain with hill descent control and specifically engineered shock absorbers front and rear.

Inside, the King Ranch cabin reflects Ford's commitment to driver comfort and control. The heated and ventilated leather seats provide all-day support, while the 12" SYNC 4 touchscreen keeps you connected with navigation, entertainment, and vehicle management. The B&O sound system delivers studio-quality audio, and dual-zone automatic climate control with the rapid-heat supplemental heater ensures comfort in any season.

Built with the professional in mind, this truck features the Snow Plow/Camper Package that opens possibilities for seasonal work or extended adventures. The reinforced suspension and electrical systems support specialized equipment, while the spray-in bedliner protects your investment. With 6 upfitter switches, you can customize power distribution for auxiliary equipment exactly as needed.

The white exterior paired with the lifted custom wheels and color-matched accents gives this F-450SD a commanding presence that matches its capability. Factory all-weather floor mats, heated mirrors, and fog lights demonstrate the practical thinking behind every detail.

This is a truck designed for owners who refuse to compromise between capability and comfort. Contact us today to schedule your test drive and experience what the F-450SD King Ranch can deliver for your lifestyle and work demands.

The 2026 F-250 Super Baja is a full-blown reimagining of what a heavy-duty pickup can be when Shelby American gets involved. Built on the already massive Ford Super Duty platform, the Super Baja transforms a work-focused truck into an off-road performance machine with serious power, long-travel suspension, and aggressive styling. Under the hood lies a 6.7-liter Power Stroke turbo-diesel V8, delivering massive torque––over 1,000 lb-ft––through a 10-speed automatic transmission. The result is unstoppable pulling power and effortless acceleration under load. Whether towing heavy equipment or blasting through loose terrain, the Super Baja delivers a constant surge of torque that feels almost unlimited. The chassis is where the transformation really happens. Shelby equips the truck with a fully reworked off-road suspension system developed with top-tier components, including long-travel coilovers, heavy-duty shocks, and a lift system designed to increase ground clearance and wheel travel. Massive 37-inch all-terrain tires, upgraded steering stabilization, and reinforced components give it the ability to absorb punishment that would overwhelm a standard pickup. Visually, the Super Baja is impossible to ignore. It features a wide, aggressive stance with painted fender flares, a functional air-induction hood, steel off-road bumpers, and a full Baja-style chase rack with mounted spare tires and LED lighting systems. Inside, the cabin blends rugged capability with premium touches. Full leather upholstery, carbon fiber-style accents, billet pedals, and serialized Shelby badging create a space that feels both upscale and exclusive. Despite its off-road focus, the truck remains comfortable and usable, with modern tech and a refined interior that matches its price point. In sum, the 2026 Shelby F-250 Super Baja is a statement piece as much as it is a machine. It takes the idea of a heavy-duty truck and pushes it into performance territory, combining massive torque, off-road engineering, and aggressive design into one unapologetically American package.

Here at Lifte Trucks 2023 Ford F-150 Raptor SuperCrew is presented with 17-inch Lock off-road wheels and Arroyo Tamarock RT tires sized 37x12.50, along with tinted windows and a Tuxedo Top that give the truck a more enclosed look while keeping the focus on its off-pavement hardware. This Raptor R equipment group is paired with a 4.10 electronic locking axle ratio, and the body includes the 5.5-foot short bed, front license plate bracket, and the Moonroof and Tailgate Package. A spray-in bed liner is also part of the build, and the exterior details are finished in a way that keeps the truck's functional parts easy to identify without adding unnecessary ornament.

This SuperCrew cab gives the truck a full-size four-door cabin with room for passengers and the space expected in a crew-oriented pickup. The panoramic sunroof adds more light overhead, and the moonroof equipment is listed with the truck's options as well. The leather seats bring a more finished surface to the interior, while the cabin remains straightforward in its use of conventional switchgear and truck-focused controls. Lane Keep Assist and Collision Warning are included among the driver-assist features, and the vehicle also has a Wi-Fi hotspot for connectivity on the move. Premium audio is part of the equipment list, so the cabin is not limited to basic sound equipment.

As a Raptor variant, this Ford is built around hardware intended for demanding terrain and higher-speed use on rough surfaces. The 4.10 electronic locking axle ratio is part of that package and works alongside the truck's off-road wheel and tire combination to support traction when conditions change. The larger 37-inch tire size and the aggressive tread pattern are notable because they are the sort of specification typically associated with serious trail use rather than standard road duty. The short bed keeps the rear of the truck compact by full-size pickup standards, and the spray-in liner protects that cargo area from everyday wear. The Tailgate Package is listed with the vehicle as well, adding another factory option to the rear end without altering the truck's basic utility.

This 2023 Ford F-150 Raptor SuperCrew includes the Equipment Group 802A Raptor R, which places it among the better-equipped versions of the line. The interior and exterior options are balanced by practical items such as the front license plate bracket and the connectivity, audio, and driver-assistance features already noted. Meet the 2026 Chevrolet Silverado 3500HD LTZ, a heavy-duty truck engineered to handle demanding jobs with confidence and capability. This gray crew cab delivers the power and functionality you need whether you're managing a job site, towing equipment, or navigating challenging terrain.

- Duramax 6.6L V8 Turbodiesel engine with 470 hp and 975 lb-ft of torque
- Z71 Off-Road and Protection Package with off-road suspension and hill descent control
- Gooseneck/5th Wheel Prep Package for versatile towing setup
- Chevytec spray-on bedliner for cargo protection
- LTZ Premium Package including convenience, safety, and technology features
- 20" bright finish aluminum wheels with all-terrain tires
- Sunroof on crew cab
- Advanced technology with Chevrolet Infotainment 3 Premium System and SiriusXM with 360L
- Heated and ventilated leather-appointed front seats with 10-way power adjustment
- Multicolor 15" head-up display
- Apple CarPlay and Android Auto integration
- HD surround vision with rear camera and trailer camera provisions
- Adaptive cruise control and multiple driver assistance features
- Automatic temperature control with dual zone air conditioning

The Duramax diesel engine is built for serious work, delivering impressive torque for hauling and towing applications. The Z71 Off-Road and Protection Package equips this truck with an off-road-tuned suspension, hill descent control, and protective skid plates, making it ready for rough conditions. The gooseneck/5th wheel prep package provides the infrastructure you need for specialized towing, while the Chevytec bedliner safeguards your cargo investment.

Inside, the crew cab offers genuine comfort during long workdays. Premium leather seats with heating and ventilation keep you supported through extended hours, and the heated steering wheel adds a practical touch during cold months. The advanced infotainment system keeps you connected with Apple CarPlay, Android Auto, and SiriusXM satellite radio, while the head-up display delivers critical information directly into your line of sight.

Safety and visibility are paramount in a truck this capable. The HD surround vision system, rear camera, and trailer camera provisions give you complete awareness around the vehicle. Rear cross traffic alert, trailer side blind zone alert, and ultrasonic park assist help you navigate tight spaces and reversing situations confidently. Electronic stability control, traction control, and a robust brake system provide stopping power and control.

The 220-amp alternator ensures adequate electrical capacity for aftermarket equipment or heavy auxiliary loads. The engine block heater supports cold-weather starts, while the remote vehicle starter system allows you to warm up the truck before climbing into the cab. This is a truck built to work as hard as you do, backed by serious capability and thoughtful engineering.

We have this 2026 Silverado 3500HD LTZ ready for you to experience firsthand. Come in to see the quality of construction, sit behind the wheel, and discuss how this truck can serve your specific needs. Our team is prepared to walk you through every feature and help you understand the value this heavy-duty truck brings to your operation.

Inside, this Silverado carries leather seats, front bucket seats with a center console, premium audio, navigation, Apple CarPlay, a Wi-Fi hotspot, and collision warning. This 2025 Ford F-250SD King Ranch delivers the capability and refinement you need for work, adventure, and everything in between.

- TREMOR Off-Road Package with rock crawl mode, trail control, and electronic locking differentials
- 6.7L High Output Power Stroke V8 Diesel with turbocharging and manual push-button engine braking
- 5th Wheel/Gooseneck Hitch Prep Package with integrated 7-pin connector
- High Capacity 11.6" Axle Upgrade Package with increased towing capacity
- Twin Panel Power Moonroof with LED roof clearance lights
- Pro Power Onboard 2kW with dual 12V/24V alternators
- SYNC 4 with Enhanced Voice Recognition and navigation system
- B&O Unleashed Sound System by Bang & Olufsen with 14 speakers and SiriusXM 360L
- Max Recline 10-way power driver and 8-way power passenger seats with heating and ventilation
- Unique King Ranch leather interior with memory settings
- Heads-Up Display with trip computer and outside temperature display
- Electronic locking rear differential with 3.55 axle ratio
- 6 upfitter switches in overhead console
- Lane Departure Warning and electronic stability control
- 20" bright machined aluminum wheels with all-terrain tires

The Tremor Off-Road Package transforms this Super Duty into a serious trail performer. The integrated rock crawl mode, electronic locking differentials, performance shocks, and skid plates work together to handle demanding terrain while maintaining the truck's road composure. Fording vent tubes protect critical components when crossing water obstacles, and the approach angle improvement from unique front air dams enhances off-road geometry without compromising everyday usability.

The 6.7L High Output Power Stroke diesel represents the pinnacle of heavy-duty engine engineering. The turbocharged design combines raw power with efficiency, while the manual push-button engine braking and Operator Commanded Regeneration give you precise control over engine performance and emissions management. The Intelligent Oil-Life Monitor optimizes maintenance intervals to keep your truck running at peak efficiency.

For serious towing applications, the High Capacity 11.6" Axle Upgrade and 5th Wheel/Gooseneck Hitch Prep Package provide the foundation for maximum versatility. The integrated 7-pin connector and five pickup bed attachment points eliminate guesswork during installation, while the prep package accommodates factory-orderable hitch kits or dealer-installed accessories. The dual alternators—12V 250 Amp and 24V 150 Amp—supply ample electrical power for trailers, campers, and auxiliary equipment.

Inside, the King Ranch trim elevates the cabin with unique leather seating, heated and ventilated front seats, and max recline functionality that rewards you after long days. The twin panel power moonroof floods the interior with natural light, while the SYNC 4 system with navigation and the B&O Unleashed Sound System keep you connected and entertained. Six upfitter switches provide convenient control for aftermarket equipment, and the 2kW Pro Power Onboard system powers tools and devices anywhere.

Advanced driver assistance features including lane departure warning, electronic stability control, and auto high-beam headlights combine with ABS brakes and multiple airbags to support confidence on every mile. The heated steering wheel, auto-dimming rear-view mirror, and illuminated entry create a sophisticated ownership experience that extends beyond raw capability.

This F-250SD King Ranch stands ready to handle your toughest challenges without compromising the comfort and technology you deserve.

Home of the LIFETIME WARRANTY!!!

The 2025 GMC Sierra 3500HD Denali Ultimate represents professional-grade capability paired with premium comfort and technology. This silver Duramax 6.6L V8 Turbodiesel powered truck features a 10-speed automatic transmission with 4WD, delivering the dependable performance you need for demanding work and hauling applications.

- Gooseneck/5th Wheel Prep Package with hitch platform and bed-mounted 7-pin trailer harness
- All-weather floor liners for first and second rows
- Front and rear molded splash guards
- Spray-on pickup bedliner with GMC logo
- Signature Denali Ultimate grille in Vader Chrome
- Bose Premium Series 12-speaker system with SiriusXM 360L trial subscription
- ProGrade Trailering System with hitch guidance and multiple camera provisions
- HD Surround Vision with trailer side blind zone alert
- 15-inch multicolor head-up display
- Wireless phone projection and wireless charging
- Heated and ventilated power front seats with heated 2nd row outboard seats
- Power sunroof and power sliding rear window with defogger
- Full grain leather interior with genuine wood trim accents

This truck comes equipped with comprehensive trailering technology that makes connecting and managing heavy loads straightforward. The in-vehicle trailering app, trailer tire pressure monitoring, and hitch view camera integrate seamlessly with the ProGrade system. Your visibility is enhanced through the bed view camera with provisions for additional trailer cameras, rear cross traffic alert, and ultrasonic front and rear park assist—critical when maneuvering a vehicle of this size and capability.

The cabin reflects Denali Ultimate refinement with heated and ventilated power seats, an auto-dimming rearview mirror with integrated camera, and a 13.4-inch GMC information display. Steering wheel audio controls, multiple USB ports with charging capability, and a universal home remote keep you connected. The heated steering wheel and dual-zone automatic temperature control ensure comfort regardless of conditions, while the power moonroof adds an open-air element to your driving experience.

Safety features include automatic emergency braking, forward collision alert, front pedestrian braking, lane departure warning, and an available safety alert seat. This 2025 Ford F-250SD Platinum delivers the capability and refinement you need for demanding work and daily driving with confidence and comfort.

- 6.7L High Output Power Stroke V8 Diesel with 10-Speed Automatic and 4WD
- Tremor Off-Road Package with rock crawl mode, trail control mode, and electronic locking differentials
- High Capacity 11.6" Axle Upgrade Package with increased towing capacity
- 5th Wheel/Gooseneck Hitch Prep Package with integrated connections
- Pro Power Onboard 2kW with dual alternators for jobsite power
- Twin Panel Power Moonroof with map lights
- B&O Unleashed Sound System by Bang & Olufsen with 14 speakers
- Unique Platinum Leather 40/Console/40 seats with 10-way power driver adjustment
- SYNC 4 with Enhanced Voice Recognition and navigation system
- Tough Bed Spray-in Bedliner with black bed tie-down hooks
- Heated and ventilated front seats with max recline capability
- 20" bright machined and painted aluminum wheels
- Heads-Up Display and auto-dimming rear-view mirror
- Automatic temperature control with front dual zone A/C
- Lane Departure Warning and electronic stability control

The Tremor Off-Road Package transforms this truck into a serious off-road performer. You'll find unique front springs for increased ride height, rear electronic and front limited-slip differentials, performance shocks, and transfer case water fording vent tubes. The rock crawl and trail control modes give you precise command over challenging terrain, while the textured matte running boards and 18" ebony black wheels complete the aggressive stance.

Built for those who tow heavy loads, the High Capacity 11.6" Axle Upgrade Package increases the gross combined weight rating and provides the structural support serious hauling demands. The 5th Wheel/Gooseneck Hitch Prep Package includes five pickup bed attachment points and an integrated 7-pin connector, ready for your hitch installation.

Inside, the Platinum trim surrounds you with premium comfort. The unique Platinum leather seats feature power adjustment for both driver and passenger, heated and ventilated surfaces, and a max recline function for true luxury. The twin panel power moonroof floods the cabin with natural light, while the B&O Unleashed Sound System delivers exceptional audio clarity through 14 speakers.

Technology keeps you connected and informed. SYNC 4 with enhanced voice recognition manages navigation, communications, and vehicle functions intuitively. The Heads-Up Display brings critical information to your line of sight, and SiriusXM with 360L keeps you entertained across the country. Pro Power Onboard 2kW delivers 12V and 24V power for tools and equipment wherever you need it.

This truck combines luxury, capability, and proven diesel performance in one commanding package. The 2025 F-250SD Platinum stands ready for serious work and refined daily driving. We invite you to experience this truck firsthand and discover how it meets your needs.

Showing only 20,000 original miles , this is a 1-owner truck with a Clean Carfax and carries Shelby CSM Number 20ST0150 — appropriately making this F-150 Serial #150. But the number that really matters is 770. Shelby offered these trucks in both naturally aspirated and supercharged 5.0L configurations, and this example was ordered with the one everybody wants: the 770-horsepower supercharged package. That transforms an already special Shelby F-150 into something entirely different. 770 Horsepower Changes Everything The Shelby F-150 was built to showcase just how far the performance pickup concept could be pushed without sacrificing what made the F-150 useful in the first place. With the optional supercharged package, Shelby takes Ford's 5.0L V8 and turns the wick all the way up to an incredible 770 horsepower . Combine that with Shelby's performance exhaust, suspension work, aggressive wheel-and-tire package, and lifted stance, and you end up with a full-size truck delivering the kind of performance once reserved for serious sports cars. That's what makes the 770HP trucks so special. This isn't simply an appearance package sitting on top of an F-150. Shelby fundamentally changes the personality of the truck, giving it enormous straight-line performance and an unmistakable soundtrack while retaining the four-wheel-drive capability, towing ability, cabin space, and everyday usability that made the F-150 such a great platform to begin with. It's an absurd amount of performance wrapped around a truck you can actually use. The Shelby Treatment The transformation extends well beyond the supercharger. Shelby reworked the suspension, exhaust, exterior, wheels, interior, and overall character of the truck to create a genuine serialized Shelby vehicle rather than simply another modified F-150. Shelby equipment includes: Optional 770HP Supercharged 5.0L V8 Package Shelby Lifted Suspension Package Shelby Performance Exhaust System Shelby Exterior Appearance Package Metallic Gray Shelby Stripe Package Shelby Performance Hood & Exterior Components Shelby Front Grille Shelby Interior Appointments Shelby Serialized Identification Shelby CSM Number 20ST0150 / Serial #150 20" Gloss Black Shelby Wheels Machined Beadlock-Style Wheel Lips Shelby Hard Bed Cover Loaded Before Shelby Ever Touched It The underlying truck matters too, and this one started with the right foundation: Ford's range-topping 502A Luxury Package and an extensive list of factory equipment. Factory Options & Equipment Include: 502A Luxury Package Navigation System Twin-Panel Panoramic Sunroof Bang & Olufsen Premium Audio System Adaptive Cruise Control Technology Package 360-Degree Camera System Trailer Tow Package 36-Gallon Extended-Range Fuel Tank Sport Appearance Package Heated & Ventilated Front Seats Heated Steering Wheel Remote Start The One To Have There is an important distinction among these trucks. The Shelby name, bodywork, suspension, wheels, interior treatment, and serialized pedigree already made the Shelby F-150 something special. But buyers could stop with the naturally aspirated 5.0L or step up to the 770HP supercharged version. This is the latter. Add the lifted configuration, loaded 502A foundation, only 20,000 original miles, 1-owner Clean Carfax history, and you have the specification that really showcases what Shelby was trying to accomplish with these trucks: take America's best-selling pickup and give it legitimate high-performance credentials without eliminating its ability to still function as a truck. And while it doesn't add any horsepower, having F-150 Serial #150 is about as perfect as it gets. The Shelby F-150 wasn't built simply to look outrageous. It was built to perform like something this size had no business performing like. And with the optional 770-horsepower supercharged package, this is the version that delivers the full experience. Between its supercharged 5.0L V8, lifted Shelby configuration, loaded 502A specification, Gloss Black and Metallic Gray appearance, only 20,000 miles, 1-owner history, and perfectly appropriate CSM #150, this is an exceptional example of one of the wildest performance trucks to ever wear the Shelby name. The Platinum trim elevates the daily driving experience with premium features including the twin panel power moonroof, B&O Sound System with SiriusXM 360L, and SYNC 4 with connected navigation and voice control. Inside, you'll find leather-appointed steering wheel, power-adjustable front seats, and an overhead console with six upfitter switches for convenient control of aftermarket accessories.

Professional detailing and single-ownership history add genuine value to this investment, ensuring you're acquiring a truck that has been well maintained and cared for. With 67,925 miles, this F-350SD remains in the early stages of its service life, ready to provide years of reliable performance whether for work or personal use.

Dual alternators provide ample electrical capacity for extended use, and the supplemental cab heater ensures comfortable operation in winter conditions. The 34-gallon fuel tank supports extended work sessions or adventures away from refueling opportunities.

With 47K miles this F-250SD Lariat is in excellent condition and ready for many more years of reliable service. The smart investment in a well-maintained diesel truck provides years of value and capability.

With the legendary Duramax 6.6L V8 Turbodiesel engine paired with a 10-speed automatic transmission and 4WD capability, this truck delivers the power and control you need for demanding tasks and confident highway driving.

- Apple CarPlay and Android Auto integration
- Denali Ultimate Package with premium appointments
- Gooseneck and 5th Wheel Prep Package for serious towing capability
- ProGrade Trailering System with integrated trailer brake controller
- Signature Denali Grille with high gloss black mesh
- Spray-on pickup bed liner with Denali logo
- 120-volt bed-mounted and instrument panel power outlets
- Heated and ventilated front seats with 10-way power adjustment
- Power sunroof

The truck's Denali Ultimate Package elevates the interior and exterior with premium materials, heated 2nd row outboard seats, and genuine wood accents throughout. Driver Alert Packages I and II provide advanced safety technologies including lane departure warning, lane change alert with side blind zone alert, and automatic emergency braking to keep you confident on every journey. The Technology Package brings wireless phone projection, wireless charging, and Wi-Fi hotspot capability, ensuring you stay connected whether you're at the job site or on the road. A 2-speed active transfer case with electronic locking differentials enhances capability in various terrain conditions, while the ProGrade Trailering System and integrated trailer brake controller make managing heavy loads straightforward and secure.

The exterior showcases distinctive Denali styling with the signature grille, polished exhaust tip, and 6-inch chromed tubular assist steps. Chrome recovery hooks front and rear provide practical utility, while LED cargo area lighting improves visibility and functionality. The spray-on bed liner protects your investment, and the power sliding rear window with defogger adds everyday convenience.

Inside, the premium GMC Infotainment System with navigation and SiriusXM Connect ensures entertainment and direction throughout your drive. A multicolor 15-inch head-up display keeps critical information in your line of sight, while the compass and trip computer provide useful metrics. Heated steering wheel, auto-dimming mirrors, and heated door mirrors combine to enhance comfort in challenging weather conditions.

This truck has been serviced, inspected, and fully detailed, ready for immediate use with confidence and peace of mind. With 43,134 miles, this 2023 Sierra 3500HD remains well within its prime, backed by the durability that defines the Duramax platform. Visit our showroom to experience this exceptional truck firsthand and discuss how its combination of capability, technology, and refinement meets your specific needs.

This 2023 Ford F-350SD Lariat in White represents serious capability and refined comfort for the professional who demands both performance and sophistication.

- 5th Wheel/Gooseneck Hitch Prep Package with integrated 7-pin connector
- Power Stroke 6.7L V8 Diesel Turbocharged High Output engine
- Lariat Ultimate Package with comprehensive safety and convenience features
- Ford Co-Pilot 360 2.0 with Pre-Collision Assist and Automatic Emergency Braking
- Intelligent Adaptive Cruise Control with Stop-and-Go functionality
- Pro Trailer Backup Assist and Pro Trailer Hitch Assist
- Head-Up Display for enhanced visibility and safety
- B&O Unleashed Sound System by Bang & Olufsen with 18 speakers and subwoofer
- Lane Keeping Assist with lane-keeping alert and driver alert
- Power-Deployable Running Boards for convenient access
- Tailgate Step & Handle for improved functionality
- SYNC 4 with Enhanced Voice Recognition and Connected Navigation
- Wireless Charging Pad for smartphone convenience
- Heated and ventilated leather front seats with memory settings
- Dual 68 AH/65 AGM Batteries and 48-gallon fuel tank

The Power Stroke diesel engine delivers the work capability this class demands, paired with a 10-speed automatic transmission that optimizes performance across varied operating conditions. Four-wheel drive ensures you maintain traction and control in challenging terrain and weather. The truck's 33,546 miles reflect careful, measured use befitting a vehicle of this caliber.

The Lariat Ultimate Package transforms this truck into a command center on wheels. Ford Co-Pilot 360 2.0 provides advanced driver assistance with features including automatic emergency braking, pedestrian detection, forward collision warning, and BLIS with cross-traffic alert. The Pre-Collision Assist system works seamlessly with dynamic brake support and intersection assist to help keep you safe. Lane-keeping technology monitors your position and provides gentle guidance should you drift from your lane.

Towing professionals appreciate the integrated Tow Technology Package, which includes Pro Trailer Backup Assist and Pro Trailer Hitch Assist. These systems take complexity out of backing up with a trailer, using visual and auditory guidance to position your load with precision. The 5th Wheel/Gooseneck Hitch Prep Package features five pickup bed attachment points with plugs and an integrated 7-pin connector, ready for compatible hitch systems from Ford or aftermarket suppliers.

Inside, the Lariat Ultimate Package demonstrates that a work truck need not sacrifice refinement. The B&O Unleashed Sound System delivers premium audio through 18 speakers including a dedicated subwoofer. SYNC 4 with Enhanced Voice Recognition keeps you connected safely, while the Head-Up Display projects critical information onto the windshield so you maintain focus on the road. Leather-trimmed front bucket seats with heating, ventilation, and memory settings provide all-day comfort, supported by power windows, automatic climate control with front and rear zones, and heated side mirrors.

The truck's Chrome bumpers, 18-inch bright machined and carbonized gray aluminum wheels, and Star White Metallic Tri-Coat exterior paint project professional appearance whether at a job site or client meeting. Electronic stability control, four-wheel disc brakes with ABS, and a comprehensive airbag system including overhead protection reflect the safety engineering expected in this segment.

This F-350SD Lariat serves those who refuse to compromise between capability and comfort. The combination of diesel power, advanced safety technology, premium interior appointments, and proven towing infrastructure creates a truck built for professionals who take pride in their investment. We invite you to schedule a time to inspect this vehicle and experience its capabilities firsthand.

- Rear Camera Mirror
- Multicolor 15" Diagonal Head-Up Display with Bed View Camera
- Premium Bose 7-Speaker Sound System with SiriusXM

- Technology Package

The exterior presents an aggressive AT4 stance finished in striking Onyx Black, complemented by a spray-on pickup bed liner bearing the AT4 logo. The truck sits on 18-inch machined aluminum wheels and features LED cargo area lighting, perimeter lighting, and IntelliBeam automatic high beams that enhance both capability and visibility. Red recovery hooks and a rear step bumper underscore this vehicle's ready-for-anything attitude.

Inside, the cabin blends luxury with functionality. Premium perforated leather seats with heating and ventilation technology keep you comfortable across seasons. The heated steering wheel and dual-zone automatic climate control extend that comfort throughout your drive. A wireless charging pad, multiple USB ports including Type-C charging stations, and a floor-mounted center console ensure your devices stay powered and within reach.

Technology integration defines the driving experience. The multicolor 15-inch head-up display keeps vital information in your line of sight. GMC's infotainment system pairs seamlessly with Apple CarPlay and Android Auto, while SiriusXM satellite radio and premium Bose audio create an engaging cabin environment. Rear camera mirror technology and bed view camera functionality expand your awareness and control of the truck's positioning.

Safety and driver assistance systems work together to support confident operation. Adaptive cruise control, lane keep assist with departure warning, and forward collision alert with pedestrian braking provide active protection. The ultrasonic front and rear park assist system, combined with trailer side blind zone alert and rear cross traffic braking, makes maneuvering this truck straightforward in challenging situations.

The 6.2L EcoTec3 V8 generates 420 horsepower and 460 lb-ft of torque, managed through a 10-speed automatic transmission paired with capable 4WD. Off-road suspension, an auto-locking rear differential, and hill descent control establish this Sierra as more than a street truck. You'll appreciate the auxiliary transmission oil cooler and engine block heater that support demanding use.

This Sierra 1500 AT4 represents the intersection of refined capability and daily practicality—a truck built to handle whatever comes next, whether that's a job site or the open road.

The truck carries approximately 30,000 miles and remains a strong choice for buyers seeking a mid-range used Raptor.

Safety and driver assistance systems are well-equipped on this vehicle. Lane departure warning helps keep you aware on highways, while rain-sensing wipers activate automatically. The Raptor includes dual front and side airbags, stability control, traction control, and a comprehensive brake system with ABS. The exterior parking camera provides visibility when reversing.

This 2023 GMC Sierra 2500HD Denali combines professional capability with premium comfort, designed for those who demand both performance and refinement. The Duramax diesel engine delivers the power needed for serious work while maintaining efficiency for everyday driving. With its 4WD system and 2-speed active transfer case, this truck handles diverse terrain and weather conditions with confidence.

The Denali Ultimate Package elevates your ownership experience with luxury touches including a power sunroof, heated and ventilated front seats, and a heated 2nd row. The Technology Package integrates seamlessly with your digital lifestyle, offering wireless charging and wireless phone projection alongside a sophisticated infotainment system with navigation. The multicolor head-up display keeps critical information at eye level, enhancing both safety and convenience.

Advanced towing and trailering features make this truck exceptionally capable. The integrated trailer brake controller works in concert with the in-vehicle trailering system app, giving you precise command over your load. Multiple camera provisions—including bed view and trailer cameras—provide visibility that transforms challenging towing situations into manageable tasks. The hitch guidance system with hitch view adds another layer of confidence when backing up.

Safety technology is woven throughout this vehicle's design. Automatic emergency braking, forward collision alert, lane departure warning, and lane change alert with side blind zone detection work together to protect you and your passengers. The rear cross traffic alert and ultrasonic parking assist make parking and maneuvering easier, whether in tight spaces or on job sites.

The truck's interior reflects Denali standards with forge perforated leather-appointed front seats, genuine wood accents, and a spacious floor-mounted center console. Rear underseat storage provides practical organization, while the spray-on pickup box bed liner with Denali logo protects your investment and maintains the truck's distinctive appearance. The signature Denali grille and polished exhaust tip signal your commitment to quality.

This 2023 Sierra 2500HD Denali represents the pinnacle of heavy-duty truck engineering paired with luxury appointments. Whether you're managing a demanding job or simply appreciate the superior ride and control a quality truck provides, this vehicle deserves serious consideration. We invite you to experience it firsthand in our showroom.

This 2026 Ram 2500 Laramie delivers the capability and refinement you need for work or life on your terms.

- 6.7L Cummins I-6 Turbo Diesel engine with Selective Catalytic Reduction
- Laramie Level 1 Plus Equipment Group
- Leather-trimmed bucket seats with dual wireless charging pads
- Ventilated and heated front seats with power adjustment and lumbar support
- Uconnect 5 Navigation with 12.0" touchscreen display
- SiriusXM 360L satellite radio with 4G LTE Wi-Fi hotspot
- Apple CarPlay and Android Auto smartphone integration
- Adaptive Steering System and Active Lane Management System

Built on proven engineering, this Ram 2500 combines diesel torque with sophisticated management systems designed to keep you safe and connected. The Cummins turbodiesel engine is paired with a heavy-duty cooling system and diesel exhaust brake to handle demanding conditions while maintaining control. The cabin welcomes you with black leather-trimmed bucket seats featuring ventilation and heating, complemented by a full-length floor console and dual wireless charging pads for your devices.

Your driving experience is enhanced by Uconnect 5 Navigation on a large 12.0" display, offering GPS guidance, SiriusXM satellite radio, and seamless smartphone integration. Advanced driver-assistance features include adaptive steering, active lane management, traffic sign recognition, and drowsy driver detection—all working together to support your journey. The power-adjustable pedals with memory and heated steering wheel add comfort on long drives.

Visibility is prioritized with automatic high-beam headlights, rain-sensitive wipers, and exterior mirrors that adjust automatically in reverse and auto-dim when needed. The center stop lamp with cargo view camera and rear backup camera give you confidence when maneuvering in tight spaces or on job sites. LED bed lighting illuminates your cargo area after dark.

The truck is equipped with a MOPAR spray-in bedliner for cargo protection and a deployable bed step for easier access, while chrome flat side steps help you climb aboard. The remote tailgate release adds convenience when your hands are full. Eighteen-inch diamond-cut aluminum wheels with black pockets complete the purposeful stance.

With its combination of advanced technology, comfort appointments, and proven diesel reliability, this Ram 2500 Laramie is ready to exceed your expectations on any road or job site. We invite you to experience it firsthand and discover why this truck is a trusted choice for those who demand both capability and quality.

The in-vehicle trailering app system simplifies towing tasks, while hitch guidance with hitch view makes hitching straightforward and safe.

This 2026 Ram 2500 Laramie in Silver is built for the work and lifestyle demands that require capability without compromise.

- 6.7L I6 engine with 8-Speed Automatic transmission and 4WD
- Uconnect 5 Navigation with 12.0" touchscreen display
- Apple CarPlay and Android Auto integration
- SiriusXM with 360L satellite radio
- Heated and power-adjustable leather front seats with 8-way driver adjustment
- Heated steering wheel
- ParkView rear backup camera
- Power door mirrors with heating elements and integrated signals
- Dual-zone automatic climate control with rear window defroster
- Remote keyless entry and security system
- 18" diamond-cut aluminum wheels
- 10-speaker audio system with HD Radio

The Laramie trim delivers refined comfort in a truck designed for serious work. The leather-trimmed 40/20/40 bench seat accommodates your crew with premium material and heating capability, while power lumbar adjustment on both driver and passenger sides keeps everyone comfortable on extended drives. The heated steering wheel and dual-zone climate control with separate rear defroster ensure every season is manageable.

Technology integration keeps you connected and informed. The 12-inch Uconnect 5 Navigation system provides GPS guidance with voice control, while built-in 4G LTE Wi-Fi and Alexa connectivity give you access to your digital life. Apple CarPlay and Android Auto bring smartphone navigation and audio streaming directly to the display, and the comprehensive SiriusXM 360L service keeps entertainment flowing across your routes.

Visibility and safety receive thoughtful attention. The ParkView backup camera helps you place the truck precisely in tight spaces, while fully automatic headlights with delay-off functionality and integrated fog lights improve visibility in challenging conditions. Heated exterior mirrors with supplemental signals and power telescoping capability enhance awareness of surrounding traffic and trailers.

Capability comes naturally in this configuration. The 4WD system paired with the 3.73 axle ratio balances on-road refinement with off-road readiness, while the comprehensive four-wheel disc brake system with electronic stability control and traction control provides controlled stopping power under various conditions. The split folding rear seat and multiple storage compartments throughout the cab optimize practical space for tools and cargo.

This Ram 2500 Laramie represents a straightforward value proposition: a truck that handles work professionally while maintaining the comfort features that make daily driving refined. Visit our showroom to sit in the premium seating, review the navigation system, and discuss how this truck fits your specific needs.

The truck delivers 14 MPG city and 17 MPG highway, providing respectable fuel economy for its class and capability. Whether you're working hard or exploring challenging terrain, this Silverado 1500 ZR2 combines luxury, technology, and serious off-road engineering into one capable platform.

Visit our showroom to experience this truck firsthand and discuss how it can serve your needs.

This 2025 Ford F-150 Platinum in White represents a premium pickup that combines capability with refined comfort for drivers who demand both performance and sophistication.

- Equipment Group 702A High
- FX4 Off-Road Package
- 3.5L V6 EcoBoost Engine with 10-Speed Automatic
- 4WD with Electronic Locking Differential
- Rock Crawl Mode and Hill Descent Control
- Off-Road Tuned Front Shock Absorbers with Monotube Rear Shocks
- B&O Unleashed Sound System by Bang & Olufsen
- Heads-Up Display
- Twin Panel Moonroof
- Connected Navigation System
- SYNC 4 with Enhanced Voice Recognition
- Unique Multi-Contour Leather Bucket Seats
- Heated and Ventilated Front Seats
- Heated Rear Seats and Steering Wheel
- 20" Painted Gloss Ebony Black Alloy Wheels

The FX4 Off-Road Package equips this truck with specialized hardware designed for serious terrain. Rock Crawl Mode delivers controlled power delivery on technical surfaces, while Hill Descent Control manages speed during steep descents. The monotube rear shocks and off-road tuned front absorbers provide the suspension geometry to handle challenging conditions with composure.

Inside the cab, the Platinum trim creates an environment of comfort and technology integration. The B&O Unleashed Sound System delivers premium audio quality across eight speakers. Multi-contour leather bucket seats with heating, ventilation, and memory functions ensure long-distance comfort. The heated steering wheel and dual-zone automatic climate control cater to your preferences in any season.

This F-150 Platinum handles daily driving with refinement and highway duty with ease. The 3.5L V6 EcoBoost engine achieves 18 city and 23 highway MPG, balancing performance with efficiency. The 10-speed automatic transmission manages power delivery smoothly whether navigating city streets or cruising open roads.

Technology on this truck keeps you connected and informed. The heads-up display projects vital information onto the windshield for quick reference. Connected Navigation with FordPass Connect 5G provides reliable route guidance and vehicle management through your smartphone. SYNC 4 with Enhanced Voice Recognition lets you control functions without taking your hands from the wheel.

Safety systems throughout this vehicle work to protect you and your passengers. Dual front and side impact airbags, stability control, and traction control provide layers of protection. The ABS braking system with brake assist delivers responsive stopping power in various conditions.

This Platinum F-150 combines the capability of a full-size truck with the refinement expected in a premium cabin. Whether you need serious off-road capability or simply prefer the commanding driving position and towing capacity of a truck, this vehicle delivers on both fronts.

Perforated leather-appointed front seats offer both heated and cooled functions, complemented by heated rear seating for passenger comfort in any season. The heated steering wheel and dual-zone automatic climate control create an intuitive environment that adapts to your needs. Wireless charging and multiple USB ports keep your devices ready without cluttering your workspace.

The technology suite elevates everyday driving. The Bose premium sound system delivers clear audio whether you're enjoying SiriusXM satellite radio or streaming through Apple CarPlay and Android Auto. The bed view camera with trailer camera provisions simplifies hitch operations, while the wireless phone projection keeps navigation and communication seamlessly integrated. The adaptive cruise control and following distance indicator take the fatigue out of long drives.

Safety and capability work together seamlessly. Automatic emergency braking, forward collision alert, lane departure warning, and rear cross traffic alert provide comprehensive protection. The 360-degree surround vision and rear park assist make maneuvering easier, while the in-vehicle trailering system app gives you complete control over towing dynamics.

Visit us today to experience the commanding presence, refined capability, and premium comfort that define the 2025 GMC Sierra 2500HD AT4.

Meet the 2025 GMC Sierra 2500HD AT4, a diesel-powered truck built to handle demanding work and deliver commanding presence on any road. This one-owner, clean carfax example in Thunderstorm Gray represents the capability and refinement you expect from GMC's heavy-duty lineup.

- Duramax 6.6L V8 Turbodiesel engine with 470 hp and 975 lb-ft of torque
- AT4 Premium Plus Package with power sunroof and Technology Package
- Gooseneck/5th wheel prep package with hitch platform
- Trailer tire pressure monitor sensors with in-vehicle trailering app
- Power-retractable black assist steps with LED lighting
- HD surround vision with bed view camera and trailer camera provisions
- Bose premium 7-speaker sound system with SiriusXM 360L trial subscription
- Heated and ventilated front seats with memory driver seat
- 20-inch high gloss black aluminum wheels
- Wireless charging and wireless phone projection
- Multicolor 15-inch head-up display
- Spray-on pickup bedliner with GMC logo
- Power sunroof with automatic rear window defogger

The Duramax diesel engine delivers the torque and towing capability serious truck owners demand, paired with a 10-speed automatic transmission and 4WD for confident control in any condition. The AT4 Premium Plus Package adds genuine luxury touches—the power sunroof, ventilated driver and passenger seats, and heated rear outboard seats create a comfortable cab environment for long hauls or daily driving. The off-road high clearance step and X31 off-road package demonstrate this truck's readiness for rougher terrain while the on-road refinements keep it composed on the highway.

Technology integration is comprehensive with the in-vehicle trailering system app, hitch guidance with hitch view, and trailer side blind zone alert making towing safer and easier. The HD surround vision system with multiple camera provisions gives you complete awareness around the truck, while ultrasonic front and rear park assist simplify maneuvering in tight spaces. Wireless phone projection keeps your devices integrated seamlessly into the available 13.4-inch GMC infotainment system.

The truck's practical features match its capability—the spray-on bedliner protects your cargo area, while the 120-volt bed-mounted and instrument panel power outlets provide convenient charging for tools and equipment. Remote vehicle starter system, push button start, and keyless open and start simplify daily operation. The premium leather-appointed front seat trim and 10-way power seat adjusters with lumbar support mean your driving position stays comfortable whether you're hauling or cruising.

Safety is engineered throughout with automatic emergency braking, forward collision alert, front pedestrian braking, and lane departure warning system working together to help protect you and your passengers. The hill descent control and exhaust brake provide additional confidence in challenging driving situations. OnStar services, emergency communication, and a comprehensive airbag system complete the safety package.

With 39,925 miles on the odometer, this Sierra 2500HD has been carefully maintained and remains under factory parameters for warranty coverage. The combination of one-owner history, clean carfax, and the truck's robust engineering makes this an excellent choice for someone seeking proven diesel capability with modern amenities.

Safety and Security
  • Forward collision mitigation - Forward thinking. You look away for just a second and suddenly the vehicle in front of you has stopped. That's when the forward collision mitigation system comes to life. When it senses an impending impact, it will activate a combination of features to help prevent or reduce the severity of an accident. Forward collision mitigation is always looking ahead.
  • Pedestrian impact prevention - An extra step toward safety. Pedestrians don't always stop, look, and listen, but with Pedestrian Impact Prevention, your vehicle is equipped to better see them and avoid them. This system constantly monitors the road ahead to identify and track pedestrians. It projects that image to an interior display screen, AND should an impact become likely, Pedestrian impact prevention takes steps to avoid a collision.
  • Rear camera - Watching your back! The rear camera helps you see obstacles and hazards you otherwise couldn't by showing enhanced images of what is behind you. The rear camera is an extra set of eyes that's both convenient and safe.

Red Wing Chevrolet Highlights
CARFAX Personal Vehicle
No Accidents or Damage Reported to CARFAX
Remaining Factory Warranty
6.6L V8 Gas Engine
Allison® 10-Speed Automatic Transmission
Z71 Off-Road & Protection Package
Gooseneck/5th Wheel Ready
Heated Front Seats & Heated Steering Wheel
Chevytec® Spray-On Bedliner
CARFAX Great Reliability Rating

From Our Used Car Manager Ryan Campion

When we're looking for heavy-duty trucks, we want vehicles that are built right and have the history to back them up. This Silverado checks both boxes. It has a clean CARFAX with no accidents reported, low miles, remaining factory warranty, and the equipment that truck buyers ask for every day.

I especially like that it's powered by Chevrolet's proven 6.6L gas V8. It's a great choice for buyers who need serious towing capability without the additional maintenance costs that can come with a diesel. Add in the Z71 Off-Road Package, heated seats, and factory bedliner, and you've got a truck that's just as comfortable at the jobsite as it is towing the camper for the weekend.

Ryan Campion
Used Car Manager, Red Wing Chevrolet

Why You'll Love It

The 2025 Chevrolet Silverado 3500HD LT 4WD is built for drivers who need uncompromising capability without giving up comfort and technology. Powered by Chevrolet's dependable 6.6L V8 gasoline engine paired with the legendary Allison® 10-speed automatic transmission, this Silverado delivers the strength needed for demanding jobs while providing smooth, confident performance every day.

Equipped with the Convenience Package, you'll enjoy features like a 10-way power driver's seat, dual-zone automatic climate control, LED fog lamps, and manual tilt and telescoping steering column. The Heat Package adds heated front seats and a heated steering wheel, while the Remote Start Package brings added convenience with remote start, rear-window defogger, and an upgraded theft-deterrent system.

The Z71 Off-Road & Protection Package enhances capability with off-road suspension, skid plates, hill descent control, Z71 all-weather floor liners, and distinctive badging. The Protection Package adds a factory Chevytec spray-on bedliner and rear wheelhouse liners, helping keep the bed looking great while standing up to hard work.

Inside, Chevrolet's latest technology is front and center with a 13.4-inch touchscreen, Google Built-In, wireless Apple CarPlay® and Android Auto™, a 12.3-inch digital driver information center, push-button start, and keyless open, giving this heavy-duty truck a modern and connected driving experience.

The CARFAX adds even more confidence, showing no accidents or damage reported, regular oil changes, six documented service history records, low mileage, and an active factory warranty with approximately 24 months or 27,500 miles remaining at the time of the report. It also earns CARFAX's Great Reliability rating, making this an outstanding choice for anyone shopping for a nearly new heavy-duty truck.

At Red Wing Chevrolet, every pre-owned vehicle is carefully inspected before it reaches our lot. We take pride in offering trucks with transparent histories, exceptional value, and the confidence you deserve when purchasing your next vehicle. Whether you're towing, hauling, or heading out on your next adventure, we're here to help you find the right truck for the job.

This 2025 GMC Sierra 2500HD AT4 is a heavily equipped diesel truck designed for serious work and capable adventures, finished in Sterling Metallic Silver with just over 23,500 miles on the odometer.

- Duramax 6.6L V8 Turbodiesel engine with 470 hp and 975 lb-ft of torque
- 4WD with 2-Speed Active Transfer Case and off-road suspension
- X31 Off-Road Package with Hill Descent Control
- Perforated leather-appointed front seats with heating and ventilation
- Premium Bose 7-speaker sound system with SiriusXM satellite radio
- Navigation system with Apple CarPlay and Android Auto compatibility
- Spray-on pickup bedliner with GMC logo
- Integrated trailer system with multiple camera provisions
- Heated steering wheel and auto-dimming mirrors
- Advanced safety suite including automatic emergency braking and surround vision cameras

The truck's powertrain delivers substantial torque for towing and hauling, backed by an 220-amp alternator and heavy-duty battery system. The engine block heater ensures reliable cold-weather operation. Interior comfort extends throughout the cabin with leather trim, dual-zone climate control, memory seats, and heated rear outboard seats. The cabin also features wireless phone charging, multiple USB ports, and an overhead console for convenient storage.

Safety and capability are woven into every system. You'll find lane departure warning, blind spot monitoring, automatic high-beam headlights with IntelliBeam technology, and front fog lights for confident visibility. The truck includes Buckle to Drive alerts, OnStar emergency communication, and a comprehensive airbag system. Advanced trailering technology includes hitch guidance with hitch view camera, trailer side blind zone alerts, and in-vehicle trailering system app integration.

The AT4 trim includes purposeful exterior styling with a gloss black header grille and aggressive 20-inch high-gloss black aluminum wheels. Rain-sensing wipers, power windows with express down functionality, and a rear step bumper contribute to everyday practicality. Winter convenience is addressed with a winter grille cover included, and the spray-on bedliner protects your cargo area from the elements.

This truck has been freshly detailed and is ready for inspection. It represents a modern diesel truck platform with the refinements and technology today's truck owners expect. We encourage you to visit and experience the commanding presence, smooth power delivery, and thoughtful engineering firsthand.

Visit our showroom to experience the commanding presence, refined interior, and impressive capability this Silverado 2500HD delivers.

A modern half-ton should be able to handle demanding work without making the driver give up comfort, technology, or everyday refinement.
This 2024 Ford F-150 Lariat meets that standard with a 5.0-liter V8, four-wheel drive, a SuperCrew cab, and only 18,747 miles. Black Metallic paint gives the truck a clean, authoritative appearance, while the Lariat cabin adds the premium materials and convenience expected from one of the F-150 lineup's most desirable trims.

The naturally aspirated 5.0-liter V8 is paired with Ford's 10-speed automatic transmission, delivering broad, predictable power for acceleration, hauling, and trailer-related work. Unlike a smaller commuter-focused powertrain, the V8 responds with the sound and linear delivery many truck buyers prefer. The two-speed four-wheel-drive system expands the truck's usefulness beyond pavement, helping with loose surfaces, job sites, boat ramps, and poor weather. Selectable drive modes allow the truck's responses to be tailored to different operating conditions.

A SuperCrew configuration gives this F-150 genuine passenger room in both rows. The rear floor is broad and nearly flat, making it easier to carry adults, tools, luggage, or secured valuables inside the cab.
Leather-trimmed seating, dual-zone automatic climate control, power front-seat adjustment, driver memory, and a leather-wrapped steering wheel create an environment that works for long days behind the wheel.
The Lariat's power-folding, heated exterior mirrors with memory are especially useful when moving between drivers or parking in tighter areas around Tampa.

The 2024 redesign places technology at the center of the driving experience. A 12-inch center touchscreen runs SYNC 4, while a 12-inch digital productivity display presents driving, trailer, and vehicle information directly ahead of the driver. Wireless Apple CarPlay and Android Auto integration reduce cable clutter, and available Ford connected capability supports remote access and vehicle information through FordPass. The interface is designed to keep common functions accessible whether the truck is being used for a Wesley Chapel commute or a full day of field work.

LED projector headlamps with dynamic bending help illuminate turns, while LED signature lighting gives the Lariat a distinctive nighttime appearance. The bed provides room for building materials, outdoor equipment, or weekend projects, while the SuperCrew layout lets the truck shift quickly between family transportation and work duty.

Ford Co-Pilot360 technology adds verified driver-support features including Pre-Collision Assist with Automatic Emergency Braking, Lane-Keeping System, BLIS with Cross-Traffic Alert, a rearview camera, automatic high beams, and rear parking assistance. These systems can reduce workload during highway travel, lane changes, backing, and parking, while stability and traction control support confident operation in Florida rain.

This truck qualifies as Ford Gold Certified under the established automatic certification rules. Gold Certified benefits include a 172-point inspection, a 12-month/12,000-mile Comprehensive Limited Warranty, a seven-year/100,000-mile Powertrain Limited Warranty, 24/7 Roadside Assistance, and applicable FordPass Rewards Points. The program adds meaningful coverage to a late-model, low-mileage truck with a highly desirable powertrain.

For buyers comparing premium pickups across Tampa Bay, this F-150 Lariat offers a particularly balanced configuration: V8 power without sacrificing modern connectivity, four-wheel-drive capability without an overly specialized setup, and a spacious leather-trimmed cabin that can serve both business and family life. It is equally ready for towing-related preparation near Brooksville, weekday travel through New Tampa, or the everyday demands that make the F-150 such a versatile ownership choice.

Your front seats offer heating and ventilation to suit any season, while the heated steering wheel keeps your hands comfortable during cold mornings. The auto-dimming rear-view mirror reduces glare from following traffic, and the overhead console provides convenient storage for frequently used items.

Enhanced suspension geometry with unique front springs increases ride height while maintaining stability. All-terrain tires mounted on 18-inch machined aluminum wheels provide grip and durability across varied surfaces. Transfer case and fuel tank skid plates protect critical components during off-road exploration.

Your audio experience comes from a premium B&O Sound System featuring eight speakers tuned for rich, clear sound. SYNC 4 with Enhanced Voice Recognition keeps you connected through careful, hands-free control while the included SiriusXM 360L service provides satellite radio entertainment nationwide. Connected Navigation with a complimentary one-year trial assists with route planning and destination finding. Steering wheel-mounted audio controls place your favorite functions within easy reach.

The truck's work-focused bed meets professional standards with a Tough Bed Spray-In Bedliner that resists dents and corrosion, along with black box bed tie-down hooks and attachment bolts for secure cargo management. The high-capacity 11.6-inch axle upgrade supports the truck's increased GVWR, accommodating heavier loads while maintaining proper weight distribution and handling. A rear step bumper and exterior parking camera make loading and backing into tight spaces more manageable.

This 2024 Ford F-250SD Lariat combines refined comfort with genuine off-road capability and diesel power, ready to handle your most demanding requirements. We invite you to visit and experience this truck firsthand.

This 2024 Chevrolet Silverado 2500HD High Country in white delivers premium capability and refinement for those who demand both power and sophistication in their work truck.

- Duramax 6.6L V8 Turbodiesel engine with 470 hp and 975 lb-ft of torque
- 10-Speed Automatic transmission with 4WD
- Gooseneck/5th Wheel Prep Package for versatile towing configurations
- Technology Package featuring Rear Camera Mirror and 15" Multicolor Head-Up Display
- Adaptive Cruise Control
- BOSE Premium 7-Speaker Sound System with SiriusXM 360L
- Chevrolet Infotainment 3 Premium System with Apple CarPlay and Android Auto
- Power-Retractable Assist Steps with LED lighting and bright trim
- Heated and ventilated leather front seats with 10-way power adjustment
- Heated rear seats with up-level storage package
- Durabed Pickup Bed with Chevytec spray-on bedliner
- 20" polished alloy wheels
- Wireless charging and Wi-Fi hotspot capability
- Rear Cross Traffic Alert and Ultrasonic Park Assist
- Engine Block Heater and 220-amp alternator

Built on the foundation of Chevrolet's heavy-duty truck engineering, this Silverado 2500HD combines capability with comfort. The Duramax diesel engine provides the torque needed for serious work, while the 10-speed automatic transmission ensures smooth power delivery in any situation. With 4WD standard, you gain confidence navigating diverse terrain and weather conditions.

The High Country trim elevates your ownership experience with genuine wood trim accents throughout the cabin, perforated leather seating surfaces, and premium audio quality from the BOSE system. The heated and ventilated front seats keep you comfortable during long drives, whether you're working or traveling. The up-level rear seat includes integrated storage, adding practicality to luxury.

Technology integration makes this truck modern and connected. The 15" head-up display projects essential information directly into your line of sight, while the rear camera mirror provides superior visibility when backing up. The Infotainment 3 Premium system seamlessly connects to your smartphone through Apple CarPlay or Android Auto, keeping you accessible without distraction. Adaptive cruise control adjusts your speed automatically, reducing fatigue on highway stretches.

The Gooseneck/5th Wheel Prep Package positions this truck for serious hauling tasks. The spray-on bedliner protects your investment, while the prep package includes the hitch platform, stamped bed holes, and 7-pin trailer harness ready for your equipment. Power-retractable assist steps with integrated LED lighting provide safe entry and exit in any lighting condition.

This Silverado 2500HD High Country represents a considered investment in a truck that works as hard as it impresses. With proven diesel reliability, thoughtful premium amenities, and practical towing infrastructure, this truck is ready for your next chapter. We invite you to experience it firsthand and discuss how this truck can serve your needs.

description: This 2024 GMC Sierra 1500 Denali Ultimate delivers premium capability with its powerful EcoTec3 6.2L V8 engine paired with 4WD, providing the performance and traction you need for any terrain or towing situation. - Bose Premium Series 12-Speaker System with SiriusXM 360L and MultiPro Tailgate Audio - 4WD with Auto-Locking Rear Differential and Denali Premium Suspension with Adaptive Ride Control - 16-Way Power Driver and Passenger Seats with Full Grain Leather and Ventilated Functions - Super Cruise Advanced Driver Assistance Technology - Heated and Ventilated Front Seats with Heated Rear Seating - Power Sunroof and Wireless Apple CarPlay/Android Auto Integration - 15-Inch Diagonal Heads-Up Display with Navigation System - HD Surround Vision with Bed View Camera and Rear Cross Traffic Braking - Integrated Trailer Brake Controller with In-Vehicle Trailering System App - Lane Keep Assist with Lane Departure Warning and Forward Collision Alert - 22-Inch 7-Spoke Ultra-Bright Machined Wheels with Spray-On Bedliner - Dual Active Exhaust with Vader Chrome Header and Signature Denali Grille - Wireless Charging Pad and Wi-Fi Hotspot Capability - OnStar and GMC Connected Services with Emergency Communication - Power Sliding Rear Window with Rain-Sensing Wipers The truck accommodates your lifestyle with an expansive crew cab interior finished in genuine wood accents and premium materials throughout. The 16-way power adjustable driver and passenger seats with lumbar support ensure comfort on long drives, while heated and ventilated functions keep you comfortable in any season. The full grain leather trim elevates the cabin, and the power moonroof brings in natural light. Technology integrates seamlessly into your daily operations. The premium GMC Infotainment System features wireless Apple CarPlay and Android Auto compatibility, making smartphone integration effortless. The multicolor heads-up display projects vital driving information directly in your line of sight, reducing distractions. OnStar and GMC Connected Services provide remote access to vehicle functions and emergency support when you need it. Safety receives priority with an extensive suite of protective systems. Forward Collision Alert, Front Pedestrian Braking, and Lane Keep Assist with Lane Departure Warning work together to help prevent accidents. Rear Cross Traffic Braking and Rear Pedestrian Detection provide added protection when reversing. The Safety Alert Seat offers haptic warnings to reinforce critical alerts while driving. Trailering becomes straightforward with the integrated trailer brake controller, trailer camera provisions, and in-vehicle trailering system app. The hitch guidance and hitch view features simplify connecting and maneuvering trailers, while the trailer tire pressure monitor system keeps you informed of tire conditions. Trailer side blind zone alert adds an extra layer of awareness during towing operations. The exterior reflects the Denali Ultimate's premium positioning with 22-inch ultra-bright machined wheels, LED cargo area lighting, and a spray-on bedliner bearing the Denali logo. Deep-tinted glass reduces glare, while auto-dimming door mirrors and inertia high-beam headlights enhance visibility and convenience. The Vader Chrome Header with signature Denali grille commands attention, establishing this truck's distinctive presence. Memorial Highway Chevrolet Windber presents this exceptional 2024 Chevrolet Silverado 2500HD, combining heavy-duty capability with premium comfort. Stock #6324A / VIN: 2GC4YRE7XR1114951

Under the hood sits a commanding 6.6L V8 gas engine delivering 401 horsepower and 464 lb-ft of torque, paired with the legendary Allison 10-speed automatic transmission. This four-wheel-drive beast features a 3.73 rear axle ratio, active electronic Autotrac transfer case, and auto-locking rear differential. With a 10,850 lbs GVWR and comprehensive trailering package including hitch guidance and integrated trailer brake controller, this Silverado is engineered to handle your toughest jobs.

The front bucket seats feature **both heating and ventilation** for year-round comfort, while 10-way power adjustments with lumbar support ensure the perfect driving position. Even rear passengers enjoy **heated outboard seats** with the up-level 60/40 split bench. The **heated, wrapped steering wheel** adds another touch of luxury, complemented by dual-zone automatic climate control.

Stay connected with the Chevrolet Infotainment 3 Premium system featuring a massive 13.4" HD touchscreen with **wireless Apple CarPlay and Android Auto**. The premium Bose 7-speaker sound system delivers concert-quality audio, while wireless charging keeps your devices powered. The 12.3" digital driver display provides customizable information at a glance.

**EXTERIOR DISTINCTION**
Finished in pristine Summit White with chrome accents, polished 20" wheels, and chromed 6" assist steps, this Silverado commands attention. The factory-installed Chevytec spray-on bedliner protects your investment, while LED lighting throughout ensures maximum visibility.

**SAFETY & CONVENIENCE**
Equipped with HD Surround Vision, Front and Rear Park Assist, Automatic Emergency Braking, Lane Departure Warning, and Trailer Side Blind Zone Alert. Push-button start, remote start, and keyless entry add everyday convenience.

This 2024 Ram 2500 Rebel in gray delivers the capability and refinement you expect from a premium heavy-duty truck. The Level 2 Equipment Group elevates your daily experience with comprehensive technology. The 12-inch touchscreen Uconnect 5 navigation system integrates seamlessly with Apple CarPlay and Android Auto, keeping you connected whether you're navigating city streets or remote job sites. The premium harman/kardon audio system with 17 speakers transforms every drive into an audio experience. Intelligent features like blind spot and cross path detection, along with the rear cargo view camera, enhance safety and situational awareness.

Comfort meets functionality inside this Rebel. The heated power driver seat with 8-way adjustment and lumbar support accommodates long workdays, while the heated steering wheel and dual-zone climate control ensure comfort in any season. The cold weather group, including the engine block heater, prepares this truck for harsh New England winters. Premium materials like the leather steering wheel and luxury door trim panels create an upscale environment.

The Rebel trim's distinctive styling—with the sport performance hood, LED projector headlamps, and 17-inch black-painted aluminum wheels—sets this truck apart. Power-heated mirrors with memory, heated door mirrors with running lights, and auto-dimming capability provide practical luxury. The power-folding mirrors with memory simplify parking in tight spaces, while the remote proximity keyless entry with universal garage door opener adds convenience.

Technology enhances both capability and connectivity. SiriusXM with 360L brings satellite radio entertainment and real-time traffic. The global telematics module, Alexa Built-In, and 4G LTE Wi-Fi hot spot keep you informed and in touch. Off-road information pages and trailer tow pages provide specialized data when you need it most.

This truck is fully equipped to meet the demands of work and daily life throughout New England. With its proven diesel engine, comprehensive technology suite, and premium comfort features, this Ram 2500 Rebel is ready for whatever you need to accomplish.

The 2024 Chevrolet Silverado 2500HD LTZ delivers the capability and comfort you need for work or weekend adventures. This white crew cab combines heavy-duty construction with thoughtful amenities, ready to handle whatever you demand from a full-size diesel truck.

- Duramax 6.6L turbodiesel engine with 470 horsepower and 975 lb-ft of torque
- 10-speed automatic transmission with 4-wheel drive
- Black ChevyTec spray-on bedliner for durable cargo protection
- Skid plates protecting oil pan, front axle, and transfer case

Safety and connectivity are integrated throughout this truck. The suite of airbags, electronic stability control, and traction control provide confidence in varied driving conditions. The in-vehicle trailering app system offers real-time intelligence for towing situations, while the hitch guidance with hitch view camera aids precision when backing up with a trailer.

This Silverado 2500HD LTZ comes ready to serve as either a capable work vehicle or a comfortable daily driver. The combination of diesel efficiency, premium interior appointments, and practical features creates a truck that works as hard as you do while providing the comfort you deserve on the drive home.

Visit our showroom to experience the commanding presence and refined capability of this 2024 Chevrolet Silverado 2500HD LTZ firsthand.

The power driver seat with memory settings allows you to find your ideal driving position instantly. Dual-zone automatic temperature control maintains comfort for all occupants, and the heated steering wheel is a welcome touch during colder months.

Technology integration is seamless with SYNC 4 featuring enhanced voice recognition and connected navigation. The Heads-Up Display projects critical information onto the windshield, keeping your focus on the road ahead. SiriusXM 360L satellite radio with the premium B&O Unleashed Sound System transforms every drive into an audio experience, while remote keyless entry and the garage door transmitter add convenience to your daily routine.

Safety and capability work hand in hand on this truck. The electronic locking differential with 4.10 axle ratio provides traction control when you need it most, while the adaptive suspension with speed-sensing steering adapts to road conditions for confident handling. Lane departure warning, electronic stability control, and comprehensive airbag systems provide multiple layers of protection. The spray-in bedliner protects your cargo area from damage and extends the life of your investment.

This F-150 Raptor is ready to meet your demands. We invite you to visit our showroom to experience the commanding presence and refined capability this truck delivers.

This red F-250SD demonstrates the King Ranchs commitment to bringing luxury standards to a hardworking platform. This 2025 Chevrolet Silverado 2500HD LT combines capability with premium comfort, delivering the diesel performance and worksite readiness you need.

- Duramax 6.6L V8 Turbodiesel with 470 hp and 975 lb-ft of torque
- 10-Speed Automatic transmission with 4WD
- Remote Start Package with theft deterrent system
- Convenience Package including cargo bed LED lighting and dual-zone climate control
- Heat Package with heated driver and passenger seats plus heated steering wheel
- 10-Way power driver seat with power lumbar support
- Chevrolet Infotainment 3 Premium with Apple CarPlay and Android Auto
- SiriusXM with 360L trial subscription
- LED fog lamps and automatic headlights
- Heated side mirrors with integrated trailering capability
- 220-amp alternator and engine block heater
- Durabed pickup bed with 120-volt power outlets
- 6" chromed rectangular assist steps
- HD rear vision camera
- 17" machined aluminum wheels with all-terrain capability

The Silverado 2500HD stands as a serious work truck built for demanding jobs. The Duramax diesel engine delivers the torque needed for heavy towing and hauling, while the 10-speed automatic handles various load conditions smoothly. Whether you're managing construction operations or agricultural work, this truck meets the challenge.

Inside, the LT trim prioritizes driver comfort during long shifts. The 10-way power driver seat with lumbar support allows you to dial in your ideal driving position, and the dual-zone climate control ensures both occupants find their comfort level. The heated steering wheel and seats prepare you for cold mornings, while the remote start system lets you warm up the cab before you step outside.

Technology integration keeps you connected without distraction. The Chevrolet Infotainment 3 Premium system pairs seamlessly with your smartphone through Apple CarPlay and Android Auto, providing navigation, music, and messaging at your fingertips. The SiriusXM trial subscription opens access to satellite radio options for your commute or job-site listening.

Visibility and safety features support confident operation in varying conditions. LED fog lamps cut through poor visibility, while the HD rear vision camera gives you clear sight lines when backing up. Automatic headlights activate when needed, and the heated mirrors stay clear in winter weather. The truck's electronic stability control and traction management systems help maintain control on challenging terrain.

The white exterior paired with chrome bumpers and mirror caps presents a clean, professional appearance. Chrome tubular assist steps make entry and exit convenient, and the power-adjustable heated trailering mirrors provide the extended sightlines necessary for safe towing operations.

This Silverado 2500HD LT represents a thoughtful investment in capability, comfort, and dependability for work or personal use. We invite you to visit our showroom to experience the truck's commanding presence and refined interior for yourself.
